name: Shaper's Terrace
summary: High above Marshal's Refuge, Shaper's Terrace bears the mark of the ancient titans. Its overlook honors Khaz'goroth the Shaper and recalls the experiments that shaped Un'Goro Crater.

sections.title: A Legacy of the Titans
sections.body:
From the northern bluffs, Shaper's Terrace looks across Un'Goro Crater. Monumental stone works left by the titans crown the high plateau. The site is believed to honor Khaz'goroth the Shaper, one of the celestial architects who cultivated the crater as a living laboratory for early life on Azeroth.

From these heights, ancient entities once watched and directed the flora and fauna below. Stone arches and massive metallic plinths still rise above the wilderness thriving beneath them.

faq.answer: Shaper's Terrace rises along the northern bluffs of Un'Goro Crater, directly above Marshal's Refuge. Its stone structures were left by the titans who shaped the land.
The Shaper was Khaz'goroth, one of the titanic creators who helped craft and cultivate Azeroth in the deep past.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see another glimpse of Khaz'goroth's architecture and the grand works of the creators at Shaper's Terrace.
